body_es: Amazon CloudWatch, AWS CloudTrail y AWS Config son los tres pilares de observabilidad y auditoría en AWS. Amazon CloudWatch es la plataforma de monitorización unificada: recopila métricas de todos los servicios de AWS (y custom metrics de aplicaciones), almacena logs en Log Groups con retención configurable, permite crear alarmas que disparan acciones de Auto Scaling, SNS o EC2, y proporciona dashboards personalizados. CloudWatch Logs Insights ofrece consultas interactivas sobre logs. CloudWatch Contributor Insights identifica los principales contribuyentes a problemas de rendimiento. El Unified CloudWatch Agent recopila métricas a nivel de SO (memoria, disco) que no están disponibles de forma nativa. AWS CloudTrail registra todas las llamadas a la API de AWS realizadas en la cuenta: quién llamó, desde dónde, cuándo y qué parámetros usó. Los eventos de gestión (API calls) se registran por defecto; los eventos de datos (acceso a objetos S3, ejecución de Lambda) requieren habilitación explícita. CloudTrail Lake permite consultas SQL sobre logs de auditoría consolidados. AWS Config registra el historial de configuración de los recursos de AWS y evalúa su cumplimiento con reglas definidas. Para el SAA-C03: CloudWatch = rendimiento y operaciones; CloudTrail = auditoría de seguridad y responsabilidad; Config = cumplimiento y cambios de configuración.
body_en: Amazon CloudWatch, AWS CloudTrail, and AWS Config form the observability and governance triad in AWS. Amazon CloudWatch is the unified monitoring and observability platform: it collects metrics from all AWS services (plus custom application metrics via the PutMetricData API), aggregates logs in Log Groups with configurable retention, fires alarms that trigger Auto Scaling actions, SNS notifications, EC2 reboots, or Lambda functions, and provides customizable dashboards. The CloudWatch Unified Agent captures OS-level metrics (memory utilization, disk I/O, swap) not available natively. CloudWatch Logs Insights provides interactive query capability over log data using a purpose-built query language. CloudWatch Contributor Insights identifies the top contributors to high-latency or error patterns in logs. AWS CloudTrail records every AWS API call made in your account: the caller identity, source IP, timestamp, and request parameters. Management Events (control plane actions) are recorded by default; Data Events (S3 object-level operations, Lambda invocations) must be explicitly enabled and incur additional cost. CloudTrail Lake consolidates multi-account, multi-region audit logs into an immutable data lake with SQL query support. AWS Config continuously records resource configuration state and evaluates compliance against Config Rules (AWS Managed or custom Lambda-based). For SAA-C03 exam: CloudWatch answers 'is it working?'; CloudTrail answers 'who did what and when?'; Config answers 'what changed and is it compliant?'
example_code:
# Put custom metric
aws cloudwatch put-metric-data \
  --namespace MyApp \
  --metric-name RequestCount \
  --value 100

# Create log group
aws logs create-log-group --log-group-name /aws/lambda/my-function

# Put log events
aws logs put-log-events \
  --log-group-name /aws/lambda/my-function \
  --log-stream-name 2024-01-15 \
  --log-events timestamp=$(date +%s)000,message="Request processed"

# Create CloudTrail
aws cloudtrail create-trail --name my-trail --s3-bucket-name my-bucket
